meta.name: subagent-driven-development
meta.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体并行执行独立任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前会话中同时推进多个独立实现任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute independent tasks in parallel with subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple independent implementation tasks concurrently in the same session

howto.what: Claude会按照你给出的实施计划，自动为每个独立任务创建临时子代理来执行代码，并自动检查代码规范和质量，修复发现的问题，最后对整个分支进行综合审查。整个过程无需你中途干预。
howto.when: 当你提供了一个包含多个独立任务的实施计划，并且希望在同一次对话中完成执行时触发。

say.text: 请执行我的实现计划，任务之间相互独立。
say.note: Claude会按计划逐步执行，自动审查并修复问题。

say.text: 请为每个任务分配独立的实施子代理，并自动审查代码质量。
say.note: 子代理会独立完成任务并接受审查。

say.text: 请自动完成所有任务的实现和审查，无需我每步确认。
say.note: Claude会连续执行直到完成或遇到阻塞。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically creates a fresh subagent for each independent task in your implementation plan, implements code, runs task reviews (spec compliance + code quality), fixes issues, and performs a final whole-branch review. No human intervention between tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an implementation plan with mostly independent tasks and want to execute it in the current session without stopping.

say_en.text: Execute my implementation plan with independent tasks.
say_en.note: Claude will execute each task via subagent and review.

say_en.text: Assign a fresh subagent per task and auto-review code.
say_en.note: Each subagent handles its task independently.

say_en.text: Automate all tasks implementation and review without my input.
say_en.note: Claude runs continuously until done or blocked.
